title: Medical Laboratory Science Practice
topics: The laboratory profession and its sections

items.q: Serum may be defined as
o: the fluid left after blood has clotted and the cells and clot have been removed
a drop of specimen placed on a slide under a cover slip and viewed directly
an instrument that uses lenses to make very small objects visible in detail
a substance used in a test because it reacts with what is being measured
items.s: Serum: the fluid left after blood has clotted and the cells and clot have been removed. The other options describe Microscope, Wet preparation, Reagent.

items.q: Which term is described by “a tube containing everything except the substance of interest, used to zero the instrument”?
o: Pipette
Filtration
Reagent
Blank

items.s: Meniscus: the curved surface of a liquid in a tube, read at eye level to measure volume. The other options describe Biological safety cabinet, Sharps container, Stage micrometer.

items.q: All of the following belong to Microbiology practice EXCEPT

items.s: Every other option belongs to Microbiology practice. “Blood bank” belongs to The laboratory profession and its sections, not Microbiology practice.
